BiblicalUsage: Jehubbah was a son of Shamer of the tribe of Asher, named among his brothers Ahi and Rohgah and Aram. He stands in the genealogy of Asher with his household.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God keeps the sons of Asher as carefully as the sons of Judah, and Jehubbah is named because he belongs.
